'''Syni IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Syni system/Legends|Syni system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces [[Siege on Syni IV|attempted]] to besiege the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Imperial garrison (Syni IV)|Imperial garrison]]. The [[Unidentified Rebel commander (Syni IV)|Rebel commanding officer]] cut off the remote [[Star system/Legends|system]] by jamming [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]] communications and bombarded the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] using over-the-horizon [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] from outside the garrison's weapons range. While the jamming prevented communications, the absence of contact from the planet led the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Commander|sector command]] to send a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] to investigate. The planet was still under martial law when [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Viran Qol]] of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] used the world as an object lesson during his lecture on Imperial [[IM-455 modular garrison|prefabricated garrison bases]].<ref name="Garrisons" />
